hints.tr: Kademe alıştırmasının aynısı, sayı yerine metin: başlangıçta yalnızca ad, özyinelemeli parçada `c.path + N' > ' + e.name`.
hints.en: The same as the level exercise, with text instead of a number: just the name at the start, `c.path + N' > ' + e.name` in the recursive part.

hints.tr: `Types don't match between the anchor and the recursive part` hatası alırsan: iki parçada da sütunu aynı tipe çevir — `CAST(... AS NVARCHAR(200))`. Başlangıçtaki ad 40 karakterlik, birleştirilmiş yol daha uzun bir tip.
hints.en: If you get `Types don't match between the anchor and the recursive part`: convert the column to the same type in both parts — `CAST(... AS NVARCHAR(200))`. The name at the start is 40 characters wide; the joined path is a longer type.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
WITH chain AS (
    SELECT id, CAST(name AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS path
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.id, CAST(c.path + N' > ' + e.name AS NVARCHAR(200))
    FROM employees e
    JOIN chain c ON e.manager_id = c.id
)
SELECT id, path
FROM chain
ORDER BY path;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
WITH chain AS (
    SELECT id, CAST(name AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS path
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.id, CAST(c.path + N' > ' + e.name AS NVARCHAR(200))
    FROM employees e
    JOIN chain c ON e.manager_id = c.id
)
SELECT id, path
FROM chain
ORDER BY path;
```

expected: Ada Kilic > Bora Yilmaz > Ceren Aksoy
Ada Kilic > Bora Yilmaz > Deniz Kaya
Ada Kilic > Emre Sahin > Fulya Demir

hint.tr: Özyinelemeli `WITH` iki parçalı: başlangıç satırları, `UNION ALL`, sonra kendini çağıran parça.
hint.en: A recursive `WITH` has two parts: the starting rows, `UNION ALL`, then the part that refers to itself.
